scope: One RT01–RT06 attempt and aggregate per-installation operation plus touch custody admission; original recovery cannot be evicted to satisfy caps.

accounting.custodyAdmission: Reserve complete worst-case bounded original custody before first canonical writer submission; preserve aggregate reservation through generation/appended-operation updates. A late growth failure rolls back the governing operation under its original containment, never drops earlier obligations.
accounting.rowBytes: Count exact retained layout/home/owner/operation carrier bytes plus selected profile storage overhead; no digest-only replacement. The per-row cap applies at writer admission as well as cleanup so admitted rows fit the cleanup carrier domain.
accounting.persistentCapacity: Account actual retained rows/bytes and in-flight reservations under qualified native exclusion; concurrent writers cannot spend the same remaining capacity. Full native storage/index/WAL overhead needs its separately selected deployment budget.
accounting.collection: Count repeated original source/artifact/dependency decode, collision comparisons, RT04 recollection, transfer/receipt buffers and complete deleted-identity inventory. Field transport is bounded before full host allocation.
accounting.work: Charge every observed row/reference/allocation plus every byte hashed/decoded/copied/compared; exact settlement/archive codecs have additionally selected weights.
accounting.saturation: Refuse new reservation without eviction; existing unsettled original recovery and already admitted obligations remain retained. Cleanup does not infer expiration from age or storage pressure.
accounting.capacityRelease: Release persistent source custody only after actual cleanup commit or exact original reconciliation plus discharged archive/recovery dependencies; release working reservations only after actual native/worker containment.
accounting.deadline: Minimum of 30-second stage and governing administrative deadline, monotonically measured from admission; lock/native/worker limits separately pinned.
accounting.maxima: Individual bounds are not a simultaneous-fit or successful-throughput guarantee; exceeding any bound refuses the whole attempt.
accounting.operationRegistry: Operation and touch rows share persistent reservation/retention caps. Charge actual duplicated native carriers in each row; no unbounded operation table or future registry proof is supplied by counters.

adoption: Select exact native ledger/exclusion/codec/transport/statement/lock/archive receipt realization and independently prove concurrent reservation, full/one-over admission, large-field and commit-unknown cleanup behavior.
